acceptanceCriteria: Program transition refusals carry wire codes, with a test asserting wire.CodeOf on each refusal path.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. Found by the issue 354 lane. Refusals from program transitions are returned as plain errors rather than coded wire errors, so wire.CodeOf returns no code and callers and JSON output lose the typed refusal. Expected: every program transition refusal carries its code.

title: Program transition refusals are plain errors, so wire.CodeOf loses their refusal code
